note: City RV park at the south end of Pioneer Park, by the North Platte diversion dam in Torrington; pay by envelope. Restrooms, Wi-Fi, playgrounds, disc golf and river access in the park. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT (operator claim re-audited): the city page says 'our beautiful riverfront campground'. On imagery the RV pads (~42.0577,-104.1915) sit behind a continuous riparian tree belt; nearest water is the pool above the diversion dam ~50 m W/SW of the westernmost pads (~42.0579,-104.1925) through a tree line, and the main channel ~70 m S through dense trees. No site within 50 m over open ground -> stored 'not waterfront' stands (a view at most, and canopy blocks that).
